retrieved_chunks.title: Artificial Intelligence
retrieved_chunks.content: Artificial intelligence enables computer systems to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence, including reasoning, learning, and pattern recognition.

retrieved_chunks.title: Machine Learning
retrieved_chunks.content: Machine learning is a subset of AI where systems learn patterns from data and use those patterns to make predictions or decisions.

retrieved_chunks.title: AI Agents
retrieved_chunks.content: AI agents combine language models, tools, memory, and workflows to perform multi-step tasks.
